caption: The video captures an outdoor basketball court where two parallel lines of young children in yellow jerseys, white socks and pink headbands stand facing one another, each cradling a teal ball printed with a cartoon face. For much of the excerpt they hold their balls at chest height with only small postural shifts. The front child on the left opens her mouth as if chanting. A coordinated toss then travels through each line, starting at the back and rippling toward the front as the children lift and release their balls. The teal balls rise and arc through the air above the outstretched arms. The children lean forward with open hands as the balls descend toward the court. They bend to receive the last airborne balls, drawing them back in. The lines straighten to the upright holding stance while the pale wall, trees, purple megaphone prop and blue tube stay fixed behind a constant camera frame.
relations: The back to front coordinated toss prompts each child to sequentially lift and release their teal ball.
Releasing the balls causes them to rise and arc through the air above the children's outstretched arms.
As the balls descend toward the court, the children lean forward and bend to receive them.
Drawing the balls back in allows the children to straighten to the upright holding stance.
